notes: S-014 Product Decision Closure (PD-008, 2026-09-27), the final open item from the Historical Revalidation Residual Closure pass. Utkarsh decided Option B: a valid request id the viewer lacks permission for must be observably indistinguishable from a nonexistent one. Implemented across all four governed request-detail routes sharing the same fetch-record-then-AuthGate pattern (reviews/[requestId], reviews/change-requests/[requestId], reviews/commercial-versions/[requestId], customers/[customerKey]/go-live/[requestId]): a new lacksRecordPermission helper (src/components/product/auth-gate.tsx), scoped to the active-session case only (unauthenticated/unprovisioned/inactive/unavailable are unaffected, still handled by AuthGate as before), calls notFound() instead of rendering AuthGate's own 'Access restricted' message. Two new not-found.tsx boundaries (src/app/reviews/not-found.tsx, src/app/customers/[customerKey]/go-live/[requestId]/not-found.tsx) render a new shared RequestUnavailable component: 'Request unavailable / This request is unavailable or you do not have access to it.' The underlying authorization check itself is unchanged; only which UI branch runs on denial changed. AuthGate itself was not modified, so every other page using it (operations/queue, my-work, approvals, Settings) is unaffected. Regression: 4 new tests in auth-gate.test.tsx; full suite 1040/1040 passing; tsc clean. Manual UX verified live with nexus-test-restricted@example.test (confirmed zero permissions): a malformed id, a nonexistent id, and a real existing record this account lacks permission for all three now render byte-for-byte identical output with the same 200 OK response. Re-verified nexus-test-maker@example.test (the S-006 fixture's own creator) is unaffected, full detail page renders normally.
